headline.text: L1 *hot water failure* from 04:00 prevented completion of equipment cleaning; both boilers shut down instead of one.

summary: Hot water outage at L1 since 04:00 left cleaning incomplete and three wash areas with ice-cold water only. L3 ML4 Depositor #2 turned over dirty at shift change. L1 S3 checkweigher reading ±2g after calibration; multiple quality issues across L3.

food_safety.title: S3 checkweigher accuracy ±2g after calibration
food_safety.summary: Checkweigher still reading ±2g variance after calibration; suspect scale levelness and contact issues (one scale missing foot earlier).
food_safety.status: Open — team monitoring weighing method and scale condition; infeed belt speed at 78 ft/min (within 90 ft/min limit).

quality.title: ML2 chocolate melting issues with specific lot
quality.summary: Pallet on carousel struggling to melt; operator mixing with good pallet to right of PTL; two lots being combined.
quality.status: Open — QA to follow up with lead Monday; problematic pallet identified on carousel.

quality.title: ML4 TG4 lot number ejode placement issue
quality.summary: TG4 ejode not placing lot number on bars correctly; maintenance working on repair.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance completed repair; lot number printing correctly.

quality.title: Truffle bottom appearance out of spec
quality.summary: Truffle bottoms not uniform rectangular shape per spec; Preston requested adjustments and monitoring.
quality.status: Adjustments made and improvement seen at 10:11; continued monitoring requested for drift.

quality.title: ML4 broken bars at gondola exit after belt jam
quality.summary: Bars breaking at gondola exit on opposite side from previous incidents; EE posted to remove broken bars; belt to TG4 wasn't moving and had dirty rollers.
quality.status: Open — EE monitoring discharge through end of run; root cause under investigation (bars fell off belt, piled up).

quality.title: Truffle Line — 5 opened pieces in final box
quality.summary: Visual inspection found 5 opened pieces out of 258 total in final box (1.9% defect rate).
quality.status: Resolved — defects identified and removed at inspection.

sanitation.title: Hot water failure from 04:00 — cleaning incomplete
sanitation.summary: Both boilers drained instead of one; no hot water since 04:00; bins, trays, and matrixes (mm3, 4, 5) not fully finished; only wash area 1 had warm water.
sanitation.status: Open — one boiler being refilled; parts cleaned but unassembled in totes; second boiler inspection Monday afternoon.

sanitation.title: ML4 Depositor #2 turned over dirty at shift change
sanitation.summary: Depositor #2 handed off dirty from 2nd to 3rd shift; operator reminded to ensure cleanliness at every shift handover.
sanitation.status: Resolved — 3rd shift cleaned depositor before startup.

sanitation.title: S4 mixing tank not blending correctly
sanitation.summary: Mixing tank at 40hz not mixing ingredients as fast as previous day; resolved by emptying, hosing out sugar residue, and cleaning filter.
sanitation.status: Resolved — tank rinsed, filter checked, mixing restored; screen and magnet check recorded in SafetyChain.

opportunities.text: Review boiler shutdown procedures to ensure one remains operational during inspections — based on both boilers drained overnight causing 9+ hour hot water outage.
Consider reviewing S3 checkweigher scale maintenance (levelness, feet, contact clearance) — based on persistent ±2g variance after calibration at 00:34.
Consider adding depositor cleanliness verification to ML4 shift-handover checklist — based on Depositor #2 turned over dirty at 05:43.
